root_cause: Two control-plane contracts lagged their canonical authorities: Netlify production workflow push filters did not include tools/ci/** although the shared applicability classifier marks tools/ci as governance-only, and the Skill Projection regression still required fetch-depth 0 after the workflow intentionally moved to bounded fetch-depth 2.

evidence.skill_projection_failure: tests/brain-learning-canonicalization-gate-v1.test.mjs expected fetch-depth 0 while powerhouse-skill-projection.yml uses fetch-depth 2

prevention.netlify_early_trigger: Both Production Source Snapshot and Production Release Readback ignore tools/ci/** when it is the only changed domain.
prevention.netlify_runtime_authority: tools/delivery/netlify-deployment-applicability.mjs remains the canonical in-job applicability authority.
prevention.skill_projection_checkout: Regression asserts bounded fetch-depth 2 plus github.event.before base identity instead of obsolete full-history checkout.
